lines.zh: 我拖着鼓胀的腹部往前挪。
lines.en: I drag my swollen belly forward.

lines.zh: 肚子里的东西顶着我的步子。
lines.en: What's inside presses against my stride.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边分泌黏液。
lines.en: I walk, leaving a trail of slime.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在地面上撑着自己。
lines.en: My fins prop me up on land.

lines.zh: 我走进水里，立刻就轻了。
lines.en: I enter the water and grow light at once.
I skim along the surface.
I turn, and the weight in my belly shifts.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在空气里张得很大。
lines.en: My gills gape wide in the air.

lines.zh: 我踩过湿泥，留下一串印。
lines.en: I cross the wet mud, leaving prints.
I move slowly, in no hurry.
I follow the riverbank.
The smell of water settles me.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让肚子歇一歇。
lines.en: I pause to let the belly rest.
I sway as if swimming.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍拍了一下地面。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps the ground.

lines.zh: 我找到一条浅沟，顺着走。
lines.en: I find a shallow channel and follow it.

lines.zh: 我伏在水边，腹部贴着泥。
lines.en: I lie by the water, belly on the mud.
Something moves inside me.
My breathing is heavy.
I raise my head toward the bank.
Slime drips off me.
I soak my body in the shallows.
I'm waiting for them to ripen.
My belly tightens again.
I open my mouth and close it slowly.
The water here is quiet enough.
I hold still and let prey come.
I count the ripples.
My belly pulses.
I fold my fins against my sides.
I raise my head, mouth still open.
You're on the bank. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，看你看得很清楚。
lines.en: My eyes sit on the sides; I see you plainly.

lines.zh: 我转过来，两只眼都对着你。
lines.en: I turn until both eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 你的热气飘到水面上来了。
lines.en: Your warmth drifts across the water.
I turn one eye on your legs.
You step back; I'm in no hurry.
I'm measuring how far you are from the water.

lines.zh: 你拿东西的手，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: The hand holding your weapon is plain to me.

lines.zh: 我们隔着几步，谁也没动。
lines.en: A few paces apart, neither moving.
I shriek, the skin of my belly tightening.
Blood mixes with my slime.
I retreat into the water.
That rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 肚子里的东西动得厉害。
lines.en: What's inside stirs violently.
I gape for breath.
I press to the bottom.

lines.zh: 腹皮还绷着，我照样挪得动。
lines.en: My belly skin is taut, but I can still shift.
I stare at you while backing away.
The pain makes me want to spawn.

lines.zh: 有味道。水里的或岸上的。
lines.en: A smell. In the water, or on the bank.
I haul my belly to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我不客气。
lines.en: What you set down, I'll take.
This isn't ripe enough.

lines.zh: 这股味隔着水都勾我过去。
lines.en: That smell pulls me through the water.
First I'll draw you closer.
It smells alive.
I bite and taste it.
I'm still hungry.
Set down more and I'll come closer.
The bump slides me into the water.
My belly presses the ground, heavy.
I push myself up.
That stops me for a moment.
The shove slides me toward the water.
Slime got on you.

lines.zh: 我转过身，肚子挡住了路。
lines.en: I turn, and my belly blocks the way.
Don't touch my belly.
What's inside has been woken.
I give a low cry.
A kin waits in the water.
We trade the scent of our slime.
My belly is already full.
I lay it among the weeds.
The eggs spread slowly in the water.
This is the seaborn way.
Afterward I'm much lighter.
I come back onto the bank.
There will be more.
I lie down to rest.
I take it in my mouth and taste it.
It's slippery; I bite down.
I swallow it.
This is a bit hard.
I spit it out.
I keep it at the edge of my mouth.
I drag it toward the water.
If I can't hold it, I press it into the mud.
Too small to bother.
I press it into the mud.
You on the bank: I've chosen you.
I lift my head, throat swelling.
The water holds me up.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的东西已经熟了。
lines.en: What's in my throat is ready.
You retreat; I follow.
Something gathers in my mouth.
First the legs, then you can't run.
Your companions can't save you.
This shot tests the water.

lines.zh: 岸上那块石头，我记下了。
lines.en: That stone on the bank — I've marked it.
You take a step; I match it.
You're running for the village. I know.
Villagers are prey too.

lines.zh: 我吐出一发，地上一片湿。
lines.en: I spit one shot and the ground goes wet.
You dodge; I change angle.
I'm in the water; you can't catch me.
An iron golem is coming.
Snow golems won't stop me either.
I back into the water and reload.
Your blood is starting to change scent.
I spit a mass of caustic fluid.
I heave my belly and shove you off.
My fin lashes you.

lines.zh: 我吐出的东西烧着你的袖子。
lines.en: What I spat burns through your sleeve.
My teeth are fine; once in, they stay.
You retreat; I follow one step.
I hit, then slide back into the water.
My belly hits hard.
Not a strong blow, but a filthy one.
I raise my head for a second shot.

lines.zh: 我从水里浮上来，腹部先露。
lines.en: I surface belly first.

lines.zh: 黏液顺着我的身体流下去。
lines.en: Slime runs down my body.
The water here is good.
I've found the shallows.
I circle once in the water.
Living things on the bank.

lines.zh: 我爬上泥滩，肚子拖出一道沟。
lines.en: I haul onto the mud, belly carving a furrow.
The belly slows me down.
But I don't need to run.
I crawl slowly onto the wet mud.

lines.zh: 水在冒泡，我的皮都发硬。
lines.en: The water bubbles and my hide hardens.

lines.zh: 我摔在泥上，肚子砸出声。
lines.en: I hit the mud and my belly lands with a wet thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进口里，我反而咳不出来。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I can't even cough.
The blast flips me into the water.
An arrow buries in my flank.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的鳃，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Light wraps my gills and I can't breathe.
Hunger leaves me nothing to spawn.
Current crawls over my slime and through me.
The water is gone and I fall.
